note: Exploration only, CPU, owner session 2026-11-15. Reported counts for the released Z1T-0 checkpoint use a threshold: every incoming weight and its bias are below 1e-6 in magnitude. These are near-zero units under that threshold, not proven exact-zero units; their deterministic output is not asserted to equal tanh(0).
under_sampling_noise: Not established. Even a unit with exactly zero mean has nonzero variance under finite-sample output noise, so replacing it by deterministic zero changes the stochastic model. A quick check on two OpenWebText windows found no difference at three decimals between sampling these units and gating them to zero at 32, 512 and 2,048 samples; too small to report as a result.
